Resuscitate with IV fluids. Crossmatch blood. Urgent endoscopy. Stop anticoagulants/NSAIDs.

anyOfFeatures: epigastric pain in diabetic or elderly
action: ECG and troponin. Consider ACS even without classic chest pain, especially in elderly, diabetic, or female patients.
Urgent surgical debridement. Broad-spectrum IV antibiotics. ICU admission. Do not delay surgery.
